name: who_has_open
description: Query cached descriptor holders by exact cached path text, or device+inode. Does not stat or resolve the requested path. Numeric identities are unsigned decimal strings. Missing/denied/stale/capped coverage is reported; an empty page is not proof of absence. Path lookup is refused under request or server redaction.

name: get_fd_inheritance
description: Compare cached parent/child descriptors at the same fd number and kind/device/inode. A match does not prove inheritance, a shared open file description, or survival across exec. Requests fresh fdinfo flags within the existing scan budget; never starts tracing. pid filters by child, counts describe the whole cache. No paths or process names are returned.

name: start_fd_events
description: Start or renew one explicit 3-second capture; requires control (and the shared-session lease). exact mode slows all syscalls on this machine by roughly 10 % while active. Syscall-heavy targets may slow much more. Explicit cost acknowledgement required every renewal.

name: stop_fd_events
description: Stop exact syscall capture; requires control (and the shared-session lease). Retained counts remain readable.

name: get_fd_treemap
description: Read the bounded path treemap of cached descriptors. Area is handle count, not bytes; equal paths do not prove equal inodes. Never starts or renews tracing. Non-root node IDs require the sequence returned by the previous call. At most 4096 nodes, 1 MiB names and 32 output tiles; capped paths remain counted as unexpanded. Read system_flow for coverage and host tracing cost.
